summary: Brother of Maria Antonia DiBiasi; John's 3rd great-granduncle.
bio:
b. 28 Sep 1856 Guardia Lombardi; d. 8 Feb 1922 Scranton; buried in Dunmore. Married Victoria DiPietro; son John N. (1892-1974) had a son Nicholas (1919-2002).

His widow Victoria (78, born Italy) was living in April 1940 with their son John DiBiasi (46) and his family at 1009 Bunker Hill Street. That was a few doors from Grace (Petrillo) DiBiasi's grocery at no. 1015 and the Petriello house at no. 1028 ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] 1940 US census, Scranton Ward 10, Lackawanna Co., PA, ED 71-63, sheet 15A (enumerated 16 Apr 1940), Bunker Hill Street nos. 1003-1015: households of James DiBiasi (1015, 45, b. Italy), Joseph DiBiasi (1015, 47, b. Italy) and wife Grace (43, b. PA, merchant, general grocery store), Mary Magnotta, John DiBiasi (1009, with widowed mother Victoria, 78), Michael DiBiasi, and Nicholas Castellano (1003, with wife Josephine and children Vito, Carmella, Marie).
